page.layout: One printed page of running text in one column; at the left edge, the cut-off ends of lines from the facing page (a narrow strip of text fragments, treated as the edge of the neighbouring page and not transcribed).

main_text.p: profequi tam innumera, tam ingrata: & ad alia festino. Harum ne in nulla classe nomen censeri merear meum, Deum cordis mei conscium testem advoco, cui servire in spiritu filii sui ante omnia cupio, ea me mente ad hoc munus accedere, non ut propria existimationi aut affectibus, non ut alterius cujusquam voluntati aut gratiæ, sed ut unis his tribus litarem, Veritati, Pietati, paci. Et quidem spero præcorque eundem illum Deum, cujus gratia hanc miserecordiam hactenus consecutus sum vilissimus licet peccator, ut tamen essem fidelis: largiturum mihi in posterum, pro sua bonitate, ne ab eadem hac mente ullis aut mundi illecebris, aut machinis tentationum, aut temporum inclinationibus unquam dimovear. Cujus ope fretus, ut cætera non ausim polliceri quæ non sunt mearum virium, spondeo vobis tamen in fungendo hoc munere, quoad
Text is set in italic type throughout the main body.

page.notes: The left-edge strip shows fragments of lines from the facing page (e.g. "ub-", "ati-", "ri-", "pu-", "toi-") and is not transcribed. Some letters in the italic text are uncertain, notably "mearum" and "fungendo", which were read from a blurred scan. The printed marker "** 4" at the foot is a signature-style mark and was not transcribed as text. The word "quoad" appears at the foot, right of the signature mark, and is given as catchword.
